title: Image edits can use multiple references
summary:
Multiple-reference image edits, a clearer auth dashboard, and more predictable request queues led the day.

The image API accepts comma-separated URLs in the `image` parameter, and Azure GPT Image edit mode now uses every supplied reference image rather than just the first. Generated images also get a prompt-derived download filename.

The auth dashboard gained a guide to tokens and trusted domains, with examples for web and backend apps. Accepted token formats were narrowed, and authentication and cache handling were updated together.

DreamHer was added to the community app listings. It turns answers to 10 questions into an AI-generated visual of an imagined character.

highlights.title: Edit with multiple images
highlights.text: Pass comma-separated URLs in the `image` parameter to use multiple reference images in Azure GPT Image edits. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Auth setup, explained
highlights.text: The auth dashboard now has a quick guide to tokens and trusted domains, with examples for web and backend apps. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
